'''Kyle Matusevich''' (also published as '''Kyle Matusevic''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 Dagobah Regionals]] on 25 September 1999 with Big Blue, according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d55">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-29-dagobah-regional-9-25-99-tallahassee-fld55/ dagobah-regional-9-25-99-tallahassee-fl], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 29 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-29-dagobah-regional-9-25-99-tallahassee-fld55/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He finished 4th at the [[2000 Alabama State Championship]] on 29 April 2000, according to Andy McClure's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d642">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-al-states-in-birmingham-4-29-00d642/ al-states-in-birmingham-4-29-00], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 1 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-al-states-in-birmingham-4-29-00d642/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
